scope: Reduce and account temporary memory in the AC1018+ mapped-POLYLINE ownership preflight while preserving deterministic conflict detection and invalid-group quarantine.

method.kind: Focused production refactor plus generated in-memory index tests and existing six-version scratch-DWG regression

priorTemporaryStructures: A retained copy of each mapped POLYLINE's declared child handles
newStructures: An ordered set of invalid parent handles
One local sorted vector copied from the currently parsed parent list
implementation.conflictDisposition: Every subsequent parent claiming a child is marked invalid together with the first owner; invalid parents are reparsed in a second pass and their source frames and declared children are quarantined.
implementation.preflightOrder: The single preflight remains global across all BLOCK_RECORD entries and runs before block callbacks/source-frame consumption; the redundant per-block re-decode was removed.
implementation.budgetModel: The existing 256 MiB POLYLINE policy charges every non-null claim reference including repeats, conservative ordered map/set node estimates, staged-state estimates, and observed current frame-body capacity, parsed-list node estimates, and temporary sorted-vector capacity while the preflight index is retained.
limitations: Frame and parsed-list allocations occur before their capacities can be checked against the aggregate budget.
Allocator metadata, implementation-specific transient allocations, retained freed memory, and process RSS are not measured.
Malformed cross-parent quarantine is tested at the index-helper level, not with an end-to-end generated DWG source-frame collision vector.
Existing six-version scratch-DWG cases cover valid production traversal only; they are same-library writer-to-reader evidence.

validation.strictTargets: PASS: cmake --build build-gcc --target libdxfrw_dwg_reader_matrix_tests libdxfrw_dwg_local_roundtrip lc3_compat_check -j2
